entry.title: Updated: deepseek-harness-workbench-plugin
entry.summary: Fills in the Web UI's missing IDE workbench: resizable chat / editor / files-and-Git columns in Conversation, multi-tab file editing with save and new-file, workspace Terminal, a file tree with name filter and open-in-external-editor, SCM (stage/commit/push/pull, branch switch, Git graph, inline diffs), a status bar, and git_* model tools. Exact install spec: github:loadingvx/deepseek-harness-workbench-plugin. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
